pages.text: Treat a fresh wound: infection risk ×$(cfg)0.3$().
The ointment cures infection of a shallow wound.

Each open wound may get infected every $(cfg)20–60$() min. Dirt, non-sterile tools, a stuck bullet raise the risk; a bed and a dressing lower it.$(br2)Infection grows ($(cfg)4$()/h), immunity fights it ($(cfg)3$()/h). Neglected — $(l)sepsis$(): fever, falling pressure, organ damage. Antibiotics cure it: amoxicillin, ceftriaxone.
